newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Photos of Syrian and Iraqi presidents are shown together in Baghdad for the first time since Syria supported Iran in its war with Iraq in 1980s.
- Dubai strengthens its position as an international centre for the re-export of cars. More than 120,000 vehicles worth $300 million are imported annually.
- Shareholders of the United Commercial Bank and Saudi Cairo Bank approve merger of the two banks.
- The trial of two British nurses accused of killing their Australian colleaque in Saudi Arabia was adjourned for two weeks.
- Jordanian and Palestinian officials seek ways to activate trade and economic activity between the two states.
- The Jeddah-based Islamic Development Bank extends $23 million financing facilities to two Tunisian firms.
